contract: docs/SKILL-SOURCES.md, Closure receipts. Append-only: a correction adds a superseding receipt and never rewrites an earlier one. Rationale states the OMH decision in one bounded line; watch evidence stays in the private continuity record and in the cited OMH issue.

receipts.rationale: Adopted the tiered word list with its 1A/1B evidence split, the three-severity pattern catalog, and per-register profiles; rebuilt for OMH repository prose registers.
Adopted the five-lens split and the verification-gap lens shapes and evidence rules; the superpowers request/receive halves were already shipped and are not re-adopted here.
Adopted the scored ambiguity taxonomy, the five-question session cap, and per-answer write-back; spec-file paths and script preflight rejected as host-specific.
Adopted the fixed-path constitution with MUST/SHOULD semantics and the conflict-resolves-by-changing-the-plan direction; the template placeholder machinery was rejected.
Adopted requirement-quality items over behaviour verification, the CHK id scheme, quality tags, and the generator-may-not-tick ownership rule.
Adopted the per-unit parallel-stream manifest with explicit file lists, coordination points, and a conflict-risk section; the estimated-hours and speedup fields were rejected as unmeasured.
Adopted the enumerate-cluster-assign ownership derivation and the four-step overlap ladder ending in never-concurrent; the per-framework directory layouts were rejected as stack-specific.
Adopted stable FR-/SC- ids, the requirement-to-task-to-evidence map, six separate passes, four-level severity, and the capped read-only report with its metrics block.
Adopted independent typed questions over one state, a no-match option, and confidence-is-not-permission as OMH-worded rules; app-code guidance stays a pointer.
Adopted atomic questions, state as evidence, and code-side combination; every instruction string was rewritten in OMH wording.
Adopted advisory-only use and failure-is-never-an-answer as the tool's status contract; upstream wording and its sidekick framing rejected.
Adopted the Choice-plus-fits shape and one ledger row per ask through route_question/v1; per-turn injection rejected.
Adopted abstain-as-a-legal-answer; the router's non-TypeSafe wire shape and model routing rejected.
Adopted repeat detection and an access exit as Nouls under an OMH rule ladder; the next-move Choice itself was dropped because no rule reads it.
Adopted transient, missing-dependency, and access Nouls, rewritten in OMH wording with a fixed code ladder.
Adopted per-file Nouls plus a severity Score combined in code as additive flags; no outcome can approve a merge.
Adopted six questions and an ordered fail-closed ladder resembling jev-approval-rules/1; thresholds unmeasured, approve branch rejected, questions rewritten.
Adopted evidence-over-self-report as an objection-only preset; the PASS verdict and any authority increase rejected.
Adopted surface/foreground pairs, the ring token, one radius knob, and the registry ownership model as OMH contract wording; no component source taken.
Adopted CSS-variable speed and gap; the hover-only pause and unhidden duplicates are recorded as gaps the marquee contract closes.
Adopted the fonts.ready wait and teardown as obligations and the defaults as an observed reference point; Commons Clause license recorded, no code taken.
Adopted mode-dependent palettes, the three color-map kinds with an unknown fallback, and label styling through the library API.
Adopted the neobrutalism style as a checkable rule set; the unpublished shadow offset is left to the project's own token.
Adopted X/X-content pairs and the no-dark-variant rule on semantic colors as contract wording.
Adopted the tests-first iron law, the watched-failure rule, pre-answered rationalizations, and forbidden moves in OMH evidence vocabulary; the copy Hermes bundles stays primary.
Adopted the named-range review request and the verify-first, clarify-everything-before-implementing response contract as OMH reference wording.
Adopted the pairing of a design-system contract file with taste direction and a critique lane as a concept; the license is not OSI-approved, so the source stays link-only.
Adopted verdicts against a reference with pixel diff as a secondary aid as a concept; the license is not OSI-approved, so the source stays link-only.
Adopted critique as an evidence-bound lane of its own as a concept; the license is not OSI-approved, so the source stays link-only.
Adopted a capped Review Focus list pinned to owning tasks, one checkable action per step, and a proportion check as plan quality-bar lines in OMH wording.

Adopted ideal-state anchoring, a success-criteria table, a fidelity check that adds tasks, no invented MVP cuts, and effort bands as a concept; the license is not OSI-approved, so the source stays link-only.

Adopted the three-fix stop, architecture signals, and asking the user before a fourth fix. OMH's change: only executed runs of one reproduction count; a fix fails if its symptom persists or it causes, not unmasks, a new one.

Adopted a program-decidable finish line written beside a fence of paths the loop may not edit, a judge other than the builder, prior human approval for self-modifying loops, and a pre-launch failure check, in OMH wording.

Adopted four questions a new test must answer, shapes of tests that guard nothing, and a pre-fix red run for bug regressions, in OMH's TDD evidence terms; the license is not OSI-approved, so the source stays link-only.

Adopted one rule: agreeing to an idea consents to that idea only, and a plan, handoff, or code change written later is accepted at its own gate; the request-path classification is deferred to a follow-up.

Adopted intake before analysis, read-only and length-bounded session reads, speaker attribution for software-written rows and a child's parent agent, only computed figures, and user review before sharing, in OMH wording.

Adopted one authoritative contract file per service boundary, contract text read as data, and an allowlist for $ref targets, in the backend service-contract reference; consumer enumeration stays in consumer-impact.

Adopted anti-slop trigger phrases whose words earn no token credit alone, a no-edit review mode returning code-review findings, six UI review prompts, and a closing runtime record; a second keyword hook was rejected.
Adopted a post-judge cleaner pass bounded to the cycle's changed files with re-verification after it, made optional rather than mandatory; a skipped or reverted pass is never reported as passed.

Adopted Google's DESIGN.md format as the frontend contract shape: token front matter, the eight sections in order, OMH sections beside them; the earlier OMH layout stays valid and converts only on request.
Adopted Hermes' bundled design-md as owner of DESIGN.md authoring, lint, diff, and export when available; only a lint run that executed counts as contract evidence, otherwise not_observed.

Adopted Hermes' bundled grounded-citations ledger for source registration when available; its verify exit status is the observed citation check, never fact verification, and not_observed without a run.

Adopted four recurring-watch rules in OMH wording: a fixed watchlist and threshold, a failed source as unknown coverage, a per-source cutoff, and counting by event; the bundled skill runs company watches.
Adopted a host-validated findings schema, pasted material marked as data, and sdlc-review as owner of a kanban review card's transition; a return that fails the schema is not_observed, never a pass.
Adopted the new-versus-existing failure split as an origin on each failing check; the stash-and-pop baseline was rejected for an observed merge-base run in a clean detached worktree.
Adopted the same failure split per cluster: a fix handoff only for introduced clusters, a pre-existing one handed off on its own, an unproven one returned for the merge-base run; no verdict added.
Rejected the upstream commit step's stage-everything command and default verified prefix; OMH states the opposite rules: paths staged by name, and a prefix only from an observed ledger row.
Adopted Hermes' Automation Blueprints and cron as what automation-blueprint's record prepares; OMH keeps its own failure decisions, mapped onto the scheduler's own behavior, and never creates a job.

Adopted Hermes' bundled document skills as a source of materials QA rungs; a rung taken from one is observed only from its result field for that file, false stays not_observed, other evidence still counts.
Adopted dogfood's console-after-every-step rule and screenshot-path evidence; exploratory web QA defers to it when available, and its report is an observed finding, never a PASS.
Adopted the action-item fields outcome, owner, due date, dependency, acceptance, and source, with open values marked unknown; the bundled skill's extraction stays a reading of the notes.
Adopted the scope of Hermes' own redaction as a stated boundary: privacy.redact_pii and security.redact_secrets never change a file that leaves, so the residual scan runs on the shipped file.
Adopted the idea of a pseudonym mapping kept local; OMH keeps it outside the shipped file and stores none. Repository not read and license not checked.
Adopted vendor credential formats as part of the secret class the residual scan counts. Repository not read and license not checked.
Adopted the card-fill confirmation, the unattended-run refusal and the 402 receipt header as presence-gated evidence beside OMH's own typed confirmation; no host prompt replaces that confirmation.
Adopted the host's lane-answer schema, per-lane worktrees, one-shot child budget, and board completion fields as extra evidence; the verification fan-in still decides completion.
Adopted Hermes' context-file loading as a reader row: one file type per session, the AGENTS.md chain from the repository root, and a per-directory override the inventory must list.
Adopted the built-in /plan turn as the host's own and its saved file as this skill's draft; its request for complete code in each step was rejected by the proportion check.
Adopted spike's kill-first ordering, two-arm comparisons, and verdicts mapped onto decision_prototype/v1; its repository-root spikes/ directory was rejected for the declared scratch boundary.
Adopted systematic-debugging's phases as the method this skill records against, and a debugger read as one discriminating observation; a bug hidden under a breakpoint stays open.
Adopted the bundled claude-code, codex, and opencode skills for invoking a named CLI advisor only; the run stays advice with no edits, and no CLI is the default.

Adopted selected MIT-preserving companion data and original production guidance; closed resource inventory and provenance replace the full upstream wrapper, with no automatic execution or dependency bootstrap.
Adopted the AI-tell account as an on-demand human-voice reference, a reply-rule sentence and a high-precision reply-lint finding; the persona keeps the voice.
Moved the reviewed test questions and guards-nothing shapes from the TDD page into the shared test-authoring page; no new upstream material.

Adopted one test per contract row, read-back through the interface and stand-ins by dependency category (contract-tests.md), and the interface-as-test-surface and second-adapter rules (service-contract.md §7, #2507).
